identity.name: Veridian
identity.tagline: See the risk. Shape the future.
identity.one_line_description: Veridian is a climate risk analytics platform that helps organizations understand, model, and act on environmental threats before they become catastrophic liabilities.
identity.target_audience: Risk officers, sustainability directors, climate policy teams, and institutional investors at corporations, financial institutions, and government agencies who need rigorous climate data to make high-stakes decisions.

pages.title: Home
pages.goal: Immediately communicate the gravity of climate risk and position Veridian as the definitive intelligence platform for organizations that cannot afford to be caught off guard.
pages.meta_description: Veridian is a climate risk analytics platform delivering real-time environmental threat modeling, scenario analysis, and actionable intelligence for enterprise and government decision-makers.

sections.intent: Arrest attention with the scale of the climate risk problem and establish Veridian as the authoritative lens through which organizations can see what is coming.
sections.headline: The Planet Is Sending Signals. Are You Reading Them?
sections.subheadline: Veridian translates decades of climate data into precise, forward-looking risk intelligence so your organization can act before the crisis arrives.

sections.intent: Introduce the three core capabilities of the platform so visitors immediately understand what Veridian does and why it is different from generic ESG tools.
sections.headline: Intelligence Built for the Stakes of This Moment

items.title: Real-Time Threat Monitoring
items.description: Track wildfires, flooding, drought indices, and extreme heat events as they evolve, mapped to your asset locations and supply chains.

items.title: Scenario Modeling Engine
items.description: Run IPCC-aligned 1.5°C, 2°C, and 4°C warming pathways against your portfolio to stress-test exposure under multiple futures.

items.title: Regulatory Risk Mapping
items.description: Stay ahead of evolving climate disclosure mandates — from SEC climate rules to TCFD and CSRD — with jurisdiction-level compliance tracking.

sections.intent: Convert engaged visitors into leads or donors by surfacing a clear next step at the bottom of the landing experience.
sections.headline: The Window to Act Is Narrowing. Start Now.
sections.subheadline: Whether you are protecting a portfolio, a city, or a community, Veridian gives you the data to make every decision count.

pages.title: Campaign
pages.goal: Tell the story of Veridian's current flagship initiative — the Global Climate Exposure Index — and rally organizations and individuals to participate, fund, or amplify it.
pages.meta_description: The Veridian Global Climate Exposure Index is a landmark campaign to map physical climate risk for every major asset class on Earth. Learn how to get involved.

sections.intent: Frame the campaign with urgency and mission, making visitors feel they are entering a consequential, time-sensitive initiative.
sections.headline: The Global Climate Exposure Index
sections.subheadline: A first-of-its-kind open risk atlas mapping physical climate threats to critical infrastructure, financial assets, and communities across 190 countries.

sections.intent: Explain why this campaign exists and what is at stake if the data gap is not closed, building emotional and intellectual investment in the mission.
sections.headline: Half the World's Infrastructure Has Never Been Assessed for Climate Risk
sections.body: Governments issue bonds. Pension funds allocate capital. Cities build hospitals. All without knowing whether those assets will still be viable in 20 years under a warming climate. The Global Climate Exposure Index is closing that gap — systematically, transparently, and at scale. Every dataset we publish is free for policymakers, NGOs, and academic researchers. Every corporate and institutional subscriber funds the expansion of the commons.

sections.intent: Anchor the campaign's credibility and momentum with hard numbers that demonstrate real-world scale and urgency.
sections.headline: The Index Is Already Live. The Work Is Far From Over.

pages.title: Actions
pages.goal: Guide organizations and individuals to take concrete steps — from subscribing to the platform, to joining the open data consortium, to reducing their own climate footprint.
pages.meta_description: Take action with Veridian. Explore platform subscriptions, join the open climate data consortium, and access tools to reduce your organization's climate exposure.

sections.intent: Set a tone of agency and empowerment — this page is about what visitors can do, not just what they can learn.
sections.headline: Knowledge Without Action Is Just Anxiety.
sections.subheadline: Veridian gives you the tools, the data, and the network to move from awareness to impact — at every scale of ambition.

sections.intent: Present platform access tiers clearly so organizations can self-select the right level of engagement and begin the conversion process.
sections.headline: Choose the Level of Intelligence Your Organization Needs

items.title: Open Access
items.description: Free public tier. Access the Global Climate Exposure Index, country-level hazard summaries, and downloadable CSV datasets. Ideal for researchers, journalists, and NGOs.

items.title: Enterprise Intelligence
items.description: Full platform access including asset-level risk scoring, scenario modeling, regulatory compliance dashboards, and API integration. Dedicated climate risk analyst support included.

items.title: Government & Institutional
items.description: Tailored deployments for national adaptation planning, municipal resilience programs, and multilateral climate finance. Includes co-branded reporting and policy briefing services.

sections.intent: Surface specific actions beyond platform subscription — ways to participate in the broader Veridian mission and climate data ecosystem.
sections.headline: Your Participation Extends the Reach of the Data

items.title: Join the Open Data Consortium
items.description: Share your organization's environmental monitoring data and gain reciprocal access to the consortium's aggregated global dataset.

items.title: Contribute to the Index
items.description: Academic institutions and research labs can submit peer-reviewed datasets for integration into the Global Climate Exposure Index.

items.title: Fund the Commons
items.description: Philanthropic contributions directly fund free-tier access for under-resourced governments and climate-vulnerable communities.

pages.title: Reports
pages.goal: Establish Veridian as the intellectual authority on climate risk by surfacing flagship research, sector-specific briefs, and data releases that decision-makers can act on.
pages.meta_description: Browse Veridian's climate risk reports, sector exposure briefs, scenario analysis papers, and open data releases. Authoritative intelligence for enterprise and policy audiences.

sections.intent: Frame the reports library as a living, growing body of authoritative climate intelligence — not a static archive.
sections.headline: The Data That Decision-Makers Reach for First
sections.subheadline: From sector exposure briefs to full scenario analysis papers, Veridian's research library is updated continuously as the climate system evolves.

sections.intent: Surface the most recent and impactful reports so visitors immediately encounter high-value content and are drawn deeper into the platform.
sections.headline: What We Published This Quarter

items.title: 2024 Global Physical Risk Outlook
items.description: A comprehensive assessment of physical climate hazards — heat stress, flooding, wildfire, and water scarcity — across 12 major economies, with 2030 and 2050 projections.

items.title: Real Estate Under a 2°C World
items.description: Sector-specific exposure analysis for commercial and residential real estate portfolios in coastal and arid regions, aligned with TCFD physical risk disclosures.

items.title: Supply Chain Fragility Index: Agriculture
items.description: How shifting precipitation patterns and extreme heat events are reshaping agricultural supply chain reliability across Southeast Asia, Sub-Saharan Africa, and the US Midwest.

sections.intent: Convert report readers into platform users or donors by surfacing a clear next step at the end of the editorial experience.
sections.headline: Reports Are the Surface. The Platform Is the Depth.
sections.subheadline: Access the full dataset, scenario modeling tools, and asset-level risk scores behind every report — available to Enterprise and Institutional subscribers.

pages.title: Donate
pages.goal: Inspire philanthropic contributions by connecting donors to the tangible impact their support enables — specifically the expansion of free climate data access for vulnerable communities and under-resourced governments.
pages.meta_description: Support Veridian's mission to make climate risk intelligence a global public good. Your contribution funds free data access for communities that need it most.

sections.intent: Open with a values-driven statement that frames the donation not as charity but as a strategic investment in a more climate-resilient world.
sections.headline: Climate Risk Data Should Not Be a Privilege.
sections.subheadline: The communities most exposed to climate catastrophe are often the least equipped to analyze it. Your support changes that equation.

sections.intent: Make the impact of a donation concrete and emotionally resonant by showing exactly where the funding goes and who it reaches.
sections.headline: Every Dollar Extends the Reach of the Commons
sections.body: Veridian's Open Access tier is entirely donor-funded. When a small island nation's planning ministry needs flood risk projections for its coastline, or when a climate-vulnerable municipality in the Global South needs drought modeling to plan its water infrastructure, that access is made possible by contributors like you. We publish a full annual impact report detailing every grant, every dataset unlocked, and every institution served — because transparency is the foundation of trust.

sections.intent: Present concrete giving levels with specific, named outcomes so donors understand exactly what their contribution unlocks.
sections.headline: Choose the Impact You Want to Make

items.title: Data Seed — $250
items.description: Funds one month of Open Access for a single under-resourced government ministry or research institution in a climate-vulnerable nation.

items.title: Index Contributor — $1,000
items.description: Sponsors the integration of one new country-level hazard dataset into the Global Climate Exposure Index, permanently expanding the public commons.

items.title: Climate Commons Partner — $10,000+
items.description: Named partnership supporting a full year of Open Access for an entire region, plus recognition in Veridian's annual impact report and research acknowledgments.
